title: KariAlgorithm has #[non_exhaustive] but no constructor — callers cannot build it
description: KariAlgorithm in smime-tree/src/key.rs is marked #[non_exhaustive] and has all-pub fields but no pub fn new() or Default impl. This means callers outside the crate cannot construct it at all — #[non_exhaustive] prevents struct literal expressions and there is no other construction path. This is not wrong per se for a type that is always received (never constructed by callers), but the intent is not documented. If KariAlgorithm is meant to be output-only (always produced by the crate, never by callers), document that. If callers are ever expected to construct one (e.g. to pass a preferred algorithm to a future API), a constructor must be provided. What goes wrong: future API design is constrained because there is no established construction pattern. File: smime-tree/src/key.rs.
